Autism Treatment

About autism

Autism — autism spectrum disorder (ASD) — is a developmental difference in how a child’s brain grows and works. It affects how a child communicates, connects with other people, and experiences the world around them. It looks different in every child: one may speak late or use few words, another may repeat words or movements, or be sensitive to sounds, lights, or changes in routine — and many have strong memory, focus, and pattern skills. Autism is not caused by parenting, and children do not outgrow it. But with the right support, children with autism keep learning — new words, new skills, new ways to connect with the people who love them. That support is where ABA therapy comes in.

Our approach to ABA therapy

ABA — Applied Behavior Analysis — is an evidence-based way of teaching that breaks big skills into small, learnable steps. At WarmHugs, therapy is one-to-one — one therapist focused only on your child — and a BCBA designs and supervises the plan, adjusting it as the data shows what’s working. Parents help set the goals, join parent training, may observe sessions, and receive regular progress updates with data.

Communicating

Asking for what they need and want, and finding their voice — in whatever way works best for them.

Independence

Daily living skills step by step — dressing, routines, self-care — at their own pace.

Social Skills & Play

Joining family activities, playing with peers, taking turns, and feeling at ease in groups.

Behavior Support

Understanding why a behavior happens, then teaching a calmer, safer way to meet the same need.

Good to Know

Questions families ask us

When does WarmHugs open?

We’re opening in Spring 2027 in Kenner, Louisiana. The waitlist is open now, and families on it will be contacted first — places are offered in the order registrations arrived.

Where will therapy take place?

In our clinic in Kenner, at your child’s school or daycare, and in the community, as written in your child’s plan. In-school services cover Jefferson and St. Charles Parishes.

Does my child need a diagnosis to join the waitlist?

No. You can join at any point — whether your child already has a diagnosis, you’re waiting for an evaluation, or you’re still figuring out the first step. WarmHugs does not offer evaluations or diagnosis ourselves.

What happens after I join?

We reply from operations@warmhugsaba.org to confirm your place and answer your questions, then keep you updated as opening approaches. Joining is free and non-binding — you decide when we reach out.

Can I watch my child’s sessions?

Yes. Parents are welcome to observe, you help set your child’s goals, and you’ll receive regular progress updates with data so you can follow your child’s progress between sessions too.

How do I ask something else?

Email us anytime at operations@warmhugsaba.org and we’ll be glad to help. Referring providers are welcome to email a brief, non-clinical introduction the same way — please don’t email diagnostic reports or medical records.

Privacy

A short privacy note

What the waitlist collects: only what you choose to type in the form. We use it only to hold your place, confirm we received you, and send opening updates. We never sell your information.

Leaving the waitlist: email operations@warmhugsaba.org anytime to update your details or be taken off the list — no questions, no obligation.

Please don’t email health information. Don’t send medical records, diagnostic reports, insurance card photos, or detailed health history by email — regular email isn’t secure for that. If records are needed later, we’ll arrange a secure way.

No promises: joining the waitlist doesn’t guarantee a place, and nothing on this site promises specific results or insurance coverage. In an emergency, call 911; for a mental-health crisis, call or text 988.
